decision: One shared body; individual faces, hair, uniform height scale and colors.

canonicalBody.heightDefinition: Feet to bare scalp; exclude hair and hats. Exported body bounds are 0 to 1.70000005 m.
canonicalBody.restPose: A-pose specified by canonical source bone transforms
canonicalBody.heightVariation: Uniform scale on CharacterRoot, including body, clothes, head, hair and hat. Never scale only Y or fit the body to the dressed bounding box.
canonicalBody.engineeringValidation: 44 automated application tests passed, including distinct geometry for eight outfits, 96 costume/palette combinations, shared-rig deformation, four facial forms and persistent per-member selections.
canonicalBody.artApproval: Base style accepted by the user before requesting the expanded collection.

slots.body: One approved skinned body shared by every character.
slots.face: Variations of one facial base, preserving neck seam, cranial envelope, face UV and expression topology.
slots.hair: Separate object following the head, with an explicit hat-compatible variant.
slots.outfit: Separate skinned garment fitted and weight-painted on the canonical body and rig.
slots.hat: Rigid accessory with a standardized rim and attachment at head_hat.
slots.makeup: RGBA face overlay using one shared face UV layout.
slots.palette: Independent channels for cloth, trousers, fuchsia ruffles, red fabric, burgundy lining, gold trim and skin. Fabric colors do not change facial features.

productionGate.coverageMasks: Optional final optimization for areas always hidden; never replace fitting, skinning or pose checks.
checks: minimum and maximum allowed uniform scale
every approved head and hat/hair pair
productionGate.enforcement: Release-art approval gate. The playable development baseline is enabled for user review.

firstAcceptanceMilestone.result: Two visibly different characters wear the same clothing and animations, at different uniform scales, without new per-character costume fitting.

currentAssets.mila: Visual reference and legacy static prototype; no skeleton or skin weights.
currentAssets.traje-esmeralda-01: Design draft. Fit rejected; not production-approved.
currentAssets.sombrero-esmeralda-01: Design draft; must be rebuilt or fitted to the standard head/hat socket.
currentAssets.maquillaje-blanco-rulos-01: Works on Mila UV only; must be rebaked to the canonical facial UV before general reuse.
currentAssets.canonical: Shared animated stylized body with eight outfits authored in the same model space. The expanded wardrobe preserves the base style accepted by the user. Actual GLB and reproducible source included.

assetMetrics.note: Package totals include eight mutually exclusive outfits, faces and hairs; one of each is displayed. The approved base outfit slightly exceeds the 20000 visible-triangle target.
